text:
sam_support: Customer CX reported 403s and unexpected EU data residency alerts after failover. They're seeing requests routed to us-east and billing spikes. Customer org: org_42, sample request id: req_9f3b.

mike_oncall: Can you paste the error body and the request-id? Also region header if any.

sam_support: Error snippet:

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
x-request-id: req_9f3b
error: \"policy_exception: residency_override\"
message: \"Request processed in us-east-1 while org policy requires EU-only\"
```

sam_support: Customer says they made a standard API call via api.redwood.ai/chat with no special headers. Reported spike in latency before the 403s.

jordan_sre: Jumping in. I pulled audit logs for req_9f3b: see entry below from audit-bot.

audit-bot: ```
2026-06-05T14:22:33Z audit_id=aud_7832 action=route decision=fallback target_region=us-east-1 reason=capacity_shortage override_flag=enabled
```

sara_network: That override_flag=enabled is the problem — fallback policy allowed cross-region processing when capacity was low. We have TTL on region-pref cache that sometimes returns stale AZ hints after a scale event.

mike_oncall: Do we have repro steps? Can we recreate with a synthetic load test against eu-central to force fallback?

sara_network: Yes, quick repro:

1) Push load to eu-central endpoints until pod queue > 90%
2) Send request with Org header `X-Org-ID: org_42` to api.redwood.ai/chat
3) Observe route decision in router logs: `residency_override` and target_region=us-east-1

Example curl we used:

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Org-ID: org_42" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```

jordan_sre: Logged a short-term mitigation: revert fallback policy to require explicit escalation for residency-restricted orgs (PR #5247). Also clearing region-pref cache for org_42 removed the immediate error.

anna_compliance: We need a compliance ticket and to notify the customer legally. Please attach the full audit trail and timeline. Tagging legal: @legal.

sam_support: I've opened CSC ticket #14321 and emailed compliance with the audit export. Customer requested refund for the mis-billed tokens.

mike_oncall: Next steps:
- Roll out PR #5247 to staging for 1h smoke tests
- Run controlled failover load to verify no cross-region routing for residency-restricted orgs
- Backfill audit logs and create an automated alert if `override_flag=enabled` for any org with residency_policy != "allow-fallback"

sara_network: Adding a quick patch to router: check org residency metadata before honoring override_flag. Will push canary in eu in 10m.

opsbot: deploy started: canary/router-eu/sha:ff12 -> 2026-06-05T14:45:10Z :eyes: 

mike_oncall: Thanks. Sam, please hold refunds until we confirm scale reproduction and scope. We'll prioritize customer outreach.

sam_support: Acknowledged. I'll keep customer updated and share ETA.

jordan_sre: After canary, we should run a retro and add automated audits for cross-region processing incidents. Also add billing reconciliation steps to CSC.

sam_support: logged follow-up in CSC #14321, tagging billing ops.

anna_compliance: Received the audit export. Filing incident report for compliance team. :warning: Please include remediation plan and timeframe.

sara_network: Canary shows no residency overrides after patch. Will monitor for 24h and then schedule full rollout if green.

sam_support: Thanks all — closing the escalation thread for now. Will update if customer sees anything else. :thumbsup:
